settings.title: Settings
settings.mode_auto_hint: Real voice if the browser has an Italian voice, otherwise phone effect.
settings.mode_tts_hint: Callers say their lines with the browser's speech synthesis.
settings.mode_hd_hint: Neural Italian voice filtered like a real phone line. Requires a download.
settings.mode_babble_hint: Synthetic speech that follows the rhythm of the line, without words.
settings.mode_off_hint: No voice: rings and effects remain.
settings.len_adaptive_hint: Long lines are spoken faster or shortened; the text stays complete.
settings.operator_voice_hint: Your operator voice, before the answer.
settings.no_tts: This browser has no speech synthesis: the phone effect is used.
settings.no_it_voice: No Italian voice found in the browser or system: automatic mode uses the phone effect.
settings.sr_hint: If you use a screen reader, you can set the voice to «Off»: call text is still announced.

voice.sample_calm: Pronto, 112? C'è un incendio nel palazzo di fronte.
voice.sample_panic: Pronto?! 112? C'è un incendio! Fate presto, vi prego!
voice.hd_intro: The HD voice is downloaded once and stays in the browser. Until it is ready, the real voice is used.
voice.hd_installed: Downloaded. It starts on first use.
voice.hd_error: The operation could not be completed: {err}
voice.hd_unsupported: This browser does not support the HD voice.
